identity: Writer and women's rights activist · Senegal · 1929–1981
title: Mariama Bâ's birth chart
metaDescription: Mariama Bâ's chart, computed from a sourced birth date: Sun at 27.0° Aries. Birth time unknown, so no houses or rising sign.
lede: The Sun stands at 27.0° Aries, in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best. Of everything the chart can be read for without a birth time, that is the loudest single fact in it.

blocks.title: Where the Sun actually stood
blocks.text: 27.0° of Aries is the Sun's exact seat — third decan, 20°–30°, sub-ruled by Jupiter in the old triplicity scheme. The degree is the address; the sign is only the street.

blocks.title: The fast planets
blocks.text: For the fast movers, Mercury was at 26.8° Aries, Venus was at 1.6° Taurus, Mars was at 16.6° Cancer. Read together: thought that arrives already in motion; attraction that grows by reliability; effort that surges when it matters.

blocks.title: The angles that hold
blocks.text: Start where the chart is tightest — the Sun conjunction Mercury, 0.2° of separation. A conjunction concentrates rather than balances — the pair burns one fuel line. Behind it, Mars sextile Jupiter at 0.3°, and Mars conjunction Pluto at 0.3° — both still well inside the orbs this site uses. Every angle named here holds for the whole of that day at the birthplace, so an unknown hour cannot take it away.

blocks.title: What the angles build
blocks.text: the Sun, Saturn, Neptune close a triangle of trines. The closed triangle is the scheme’s picture of flow — and its warning that flow, unspent, stays private.

blocks.title: The classical map
blocks.text: Read against the old dignities, four placements stand out. The Sun in Aries at 27.0° is in exaltation — the tradition’s honoured-guest placement, working at its best; Venus in Taurus at 1.6° is in domicile — the planet in its own sign, running on home rules; Mars in Cancer at 16.6° is in fall — the tradition’s uphill placement, strength earned rather than given; Saturn in Capricorn at 0.5° is in domicile. None of this ranks anyone; dignity describes footing, and footing can be worked with.

blocks.title: The shape of the whole
blocks.text: Among the 10 placements whose signs hold for the whole day, the elements divide 5 fire, 3 earth, 2 water; by modality, 6 cardinal, 4 fixed. Fire signs carry the scheme’s forward pressure: heat applied early, patience treated as a later skill. No settled placement falls in air — an absence the tradition treats as information, not as a defect. Venus, Saturn and Neptune were retrograde — apparent backward motion from where the Earth sits, which the tradition reads as a function turned inward before it is turned out.

blocks.title: The Moon, and how far it can move
blocks.text: The Moon stayed in Leo for the whole of that day at the birthplace, covering 13.9° between midnight and midnight. The missing clock moves the Moon by half a sign at most here, and the boundary was never close. At the noon reference it stands at 8.8°.
